terms.comment: Our Monkey Tree Game: Dad holds an arm horizontally, supports his fist with the other arm, and the child jumps to grab the arm and swing from it. Sīmius et arbor works as a title without adding “game.” These are our game names, not attested ancient game titles.

phrases.latin: Ego arbor erō; tū sīmius eris.
phrases.english: I’ll be the tree; you’ll be the monkey.

sources: Our family game and its name; the grouped card gave no source.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
